blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Power Generation & Grid — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the power generation & grid operating unit of Energy & Utilities.

Grid operators balance physics, markets and regulation in real time: forecasting under intermittency, substation reliability, flexibility orchestration and CIP-grade security. The telemetry-to-decision loop is the core competency of the transition era.

items: DER flexibility activation by phone/portal; markets underused.
Renewable/demand forecasts legacy; imbalance and curtailment climb.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Decision Intelligence Systems, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Forecasting and dispatch, Asset condition management, DER/flexibility orchestration) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — NERC CIP among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.
